steps: It is a koala. Koalas live in Australia, in trees. They eat eucalyptus leaves and hardly ever drink water.

3-s71.condition: Module 5d, упр. 3, с. 71. Игра «Юный зоолог»: вопросы о коалах.
steps: What do koalas eat? — Eucalyptus leaves. Where do they live? — In trees in Australia. What do they look like? — They are grey with round ears and a black nose. Do they drink water? — Hardly ever.
3-s71.answer: What do koalas eat? Where do they live? What do they look like?
